'''Gharcanna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] living on [[Ska Gora]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tythan system]] some [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[25,793 BBY]]. He fought the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] to the death and was killed by her.
